mikan.title: Mikan drill
mikan.description: Layups with alternating hands close to the basket.
mikan.caption: Right-hand layup, catch the rebound, step across and left-hand layup
mikan.instructions:
## Purpose
Footwork, touch and layups with both hands close to the basket.

## Organisation
- One player per basket, or two taking turns.
- Start under the basket on the right side.

## How
1. Right-hand layup on the right side.
2. Catch the ball before it bounces, step across to the left side.
3. Left-hand layup.
4. Keep the rhythm going for the whole time.

## Coaching points
- Keep the ball high, never down to the waist.
- Right foot up: left foot for a right-hand layup.
- Use the backboard.

weave.title: 3-man weave
weave.description: Passing at full speed over the whole court.
weave.caption: Pass and run behind the player you passed to
weave.label: Continue to the basket
weave.instructions:
## Purpose
Passing at speed, timing and filling lanes in transition.

## Organisation
- Three players on the baseline: left, middle (with ball), right.

## How
1. The middle player passes to a wing and runs behind the receiver.
2. The receiver goes to the middle and passes to the next wing.
3. Continue the whole court and finish with a layup.
4. Same three back, or the next group starts.

## Coaching points
- Pass ahead of the receiver, at full speed.
- No dribbling.
- Talk: call the name of the player you pass to.

fastbreak.title: 2 on 1 / 3 on 2 fast break
fastbreak.description: Fast break with a numbers advantage.
fastbreak.caption: 3 on 2: ball in the middle, wings fill wide
fastbreak.instructions:
## Purpose
Finishing a fast break with a numbers advantage quickly and safely.

## Organisation
- Attackers start in their own half, defenders wait at the other basket.
- Start with 2 on 1, then move on to 3 on 2.

## How
1. The ball handler dribbles in the middle.
2. The wings run wide and deep.
3. Make the defence choose, pass to the open player.
4. At most two passes before the finish.

## Coaching points
- The ball handler stops at the free-throw line and reads.
- Keep spacing – one defender must never cover two attackers.
- Finish with a layup, not a long shot.

shell.title: Shell drill 4 on 4
shell.description: Defensive positioning as the ball moves.
shell.caption: Pass to the corner: all defenders move at the same time
shell.instructions:
## Purpose
Help-side positioning and moving with the ball.

## Organisation
- Four attackers in a box outside the three-point line, four defenders.

## How
1. The attackers pass around without dribbling.
2. The defenders move on every pass: on the ball, one pass away, two passes away.
3. Add penetration and closeouts once positioning is solid.

## Coaching points
- See both the ball and your own player.
- Move while the ball is in the air.
- Help side stands in the paint.

closeout.title: Closeout drill
closeout.description: Defender runs out at a shooter.
closeout.caption: The coach passes to the corner, the defender closes out
closeout.instructions:
## Purpose
Getting out to a shooter under control without getting beaten.

## Organisation
- Coach with the ball at the top, attacker in the corner, defender under the basket.

## How
1. The coach passes to the corner.
2. The defender sprints out, short steps over the last metres.
3. The attacker shoots or drives; play 1 on 1 until a finish.

## Coaching points
- Sprint two thirds, then short steps.
- Hand up at the ball, weight back.
- Force towards the baseline or the help.

pnr.title: Pick and roll 2 on 2
pnr.description: Screen for the ball handler, roll to the basket.
pnr.caption: Screen, dribble off the screen, the screener rolls to the basket
pnr.instructions:
## Purpose
Basic pick and roll – read the defence and find the right pass.

## Organisation
- Ball handler at the top, screener at the elbow, one defender each.

## How
1. The screener sets a screen on the ball handler's defender.
2. The ball handler dribbles tight off the screen.
3. The screener rolls to the basket.
4. Read the defence: shoot, drive or pass to the roller.

## Coaching points
- Wait for the screen – shoulder to shoulder.
- The screener stands still, rolls when the defence turns.
- Bounce pass around the help.

shootingSeries.title: Shooting from five spots
shootingSeries.instructions:
## How
- In pairs with one ball: one shoots, one rebounds and passes.
- Five shots from each corner, wing and the top, then switch.

## Coaching points
- Ready to shoot when the ball arrives: feet, hands, eyes.
- Same motion every time.

scrimmage.title: Scrimmage 5 on 5
scrimmage.instructions:
## How
- Full-court play with today's theme as a rule, e.g. points count double after a pick and roll.

## Coaching points
- Let the game flow; stop only for today's theme.

gameShots.title: Game shots
gameShots.instructions:
## How
- Every player takes the shots they take in games, at game speed.
- Finish with two free throws each.

## Coaching points
- Quality over quantity. Calm and sure.

systems.title: Run-through of plays
systems.instructions:
## How
- Walk through the game's offensive plays 5 on 0, then against passive defence.
- Repeat substitutions and special situations (side inbounds, last seconds).

## Coaching points
- Everyone knows their role in every play.
